executive_summary: This collection window (January 19-25, 2027) is the thirty-first archived window and falls inside the live Paris menswear Fall/Winter 2027-2028 week (Jan 19-24) and the opening day of Haute Couture Spring/Summer 2027 (Jan 25-28). Per SKILL.md workflow note 10, the CFDA/Vogue Fashion Fund winner and CFDA Fashion Awards questions were checked briefly rather than re-litigated; both remain unresolved as of the most recent searchable coverage and stay 'untracked going forward pending new information.' This window's central question -- whether Grace Wales Bonner's Hermes menswear debut, flagged as upcoming in the prior report, now has real dated show coverage -- was checked specifically. It does not: every search still returns pre-show anticipation, appointment, and team-hire coverage (WWD, Essence, Yahoo Finance business coverage of Hermes' share price reaction, and reference sources), not a post-show review with observed garments, silhouettes, or materials. No correction to the prior report was warranted. What is new and genuinely dated this window is the official FHCM provisional show lineup for Paris menswear FW27-28 (Jan 19-24), naming Wales Bonner's Hermes debut alongside other scheduled houses (including Undercover, Kiko Kostadinov, Maison Kitsune, and Magliano) -- an institutional scheduling fact, not observed collection content, since this report is assembled from indexed search coverage rather than a live crawl timed to actual show days. No garment, silhouette, material, or aesthetic content is reported this window for either the Hermes debut or Haute Couture Spring/Summer 2027, consistent with the project's rule against speculating about collections ahead of verified coverage.
